title: Intel / INTC down 22.90% After hours today - October 29, 2026
author: T
text:
Xebec
Well-known member

Looks like a reduced revenue forecast for Q4, and earnings of 25 cents per share vs 43 cents vs. analysts yielded a correction:

Intel warned that the PC market downturn will persist through at least the first half of 2027, forecasting a further 10% decline next year following an expected 12% slide in 2026, as soaring memory chip prices continue to weigh on demand.

.. Also:

Chief executive officer Lip-Bu Tan said the company’s data centre business would have performed more strongly without raw material shortages and a factory shutdown in Israel.

Intel estimates the disruption at its Israel manufacturing facility will reduce revenue by approximately USD600 million over two quarters, although the full financial impact remains uncertain.

This comes after a deadly explosion at Intel’s Kiryat Gat facility in Israel earlier this month, which killed two and seriously injured another, according to local media reports, cited by Reuters.
